normative_basis.rule: A sticky box is positioned relative to its nearest scrollport and shifted only insofar as its position box remains contained in its containing block; its containing block is defined by its formatting context.
For relative/static boxes, the containing block is formed by the content edge of the nearest block container ancestor.
